summary: Exposed the existing M16 PREPARE, final confirmation, APPLY, and persisted reconciliation flow through System Updates without broadening backend execution authority or executing a live device action.
completed: Added typed frontend bindings for the closed M16 prepare, apply, and one-shot reconciliation commands.
Added safe mutation eligibility, truthful preparation/starting/installing/verifying phases, bounded package review, and an explicit final destructive confirmation.
Treats PlanChanged as a refreshed review with no continue-anyway path and no dispatch before a renewed preparation/confirmation.

Resumes the same persisted nonterminal operation, polls only while the System Updates card is mounted, schedules each five-second observation after the previous request completes, and stops at the persisted deadline.
Added concise terminal, uncertain, and typed failure guidance without exposing fingerprints, transient unit IDs, raw diagnostics, or backend lifecycle labels.
Wired actual M16 dispatched-operation state into M10 action disabling while retaining backend coordinator authority.

validationCommands.summary: 3 files, 17 focused System Updates/M10 conflict tests passed.
TypeScript and Vite production build passed.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: UI never exposes arbitrary command input
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The card invokes only typed prepare_device_update, apply_prepared_device_update, reconcile_device_update, and existing M15 read commands.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Changed plans require a new confirmation
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: PlanChanged replaces the review with persisted refreshed evidence and only offers Prepare updated plan; APPLY is not retried automatically.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Conflicting actions are disabled and backend remains authoritative
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: A persisted dispatched nonterminal M16 operation disables System Updates actions and all M10 actions; no frontend lock is held during confirmation and backend coordinator enforcement remains unchanged.

notes: Risk score: 38/100 — medium. The work exposes mutation UI, but it calls only the WU096 fixed typed backend contract and received no live-device authorization.
No apt-get update, package upgrade, or systemd-run dispatch was executed against a configured device.
WU098 and M17 were not started.
